gloss: person in charge; supervisor; responsible party

definitions.gloss: person in charge; supervisor; responsible party
definitions.explanation: The person who bears responsibility for a task, department, or project. Used in both business and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {責任者|せきにんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please call the person in charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{責任者|せきにんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんです。
examples.english: The person in charge of this project is Mr. Tanaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{責任者|せきにんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}した→謝罪する：19520_shazaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The responsible party for the accident apologized at a press conference.

notes:
USAGE:
A common word in workplaces and public settings. When a customer has a complaint, {責任者|せきにんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ ("Let me speak to the person in charge") is a standard phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {責任者|せきにんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call the person in charge)
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (on-site supervisor)
- ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (manager in charge)
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (chief officer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge of a specific task — narrower scope
- ⟦{管理者|かんりしゃ}→管理者：24297_kanrisha⟧: administrator, manager — focuses on management role
